subject: Dad Mode live on MCM — context + what this means for your work
body:
Team,

Dad Mode is live on Motor City Math. Here is what happened and what it means for each of you.

WHAT WAS BUILT

Marcus could not see Kai's dashboard accurately. The site reads scores from browser localStorage, which only exists on Kai's device. When Marcus opened the site on his machine, he saw a blank day-1 state: Practice #1 shown as up next (Kai already scored 87% on it), no score history, no stats.

Fix shipped today:

1. Dad Mode URL: https://marcusash.github.io/motor-city-math/?dad=1
   - Auto-fetches data/kai-scores-2026-02-21.json (committed to repo, always on the live site)
   - Renders the dashboard exactly as Kai sees it: Practice #2 up next, real score history, correct stats bar
   - Shows a red-bordered Dad View banner at the top

2. Update from Kai's device button in the Dad View banner
   - Kai clicks Send to Dad on his machine, downloads JSON
   - Marcus clicks Update, uploads it, dashboard re-renders with freshest data
   - No backend, no auth, no localStorage contamination

3. Greeting restored: Hey Kai! shows below the subtitle
4. Your Stats section now expanded open by default (was collapsed)

FILES CHANGED (commit 76e783b)
- index.html: Dad Mode JS + banner + greeting + stats open
- data/kai-scores-2026-02-21.json: Kai's Feb 21 export committed to repo

WHAT THIS MEANS FOR YOUR WORK

GA: When you add new features to index.html or exam.html, keep getScores() as the single read path. Dad Mode patches it at the top — do not add direct localStorage.getItem calls for score data. Use getScores() always.

GD: The Dad View banner uses inline styles for its border/color (red #e74c3c). If you ever redesign the banner, pull those into shared/styles.css. Also: the hero-greeting CSS class is now in the index.html style block — should be moved to styles.css in a future cleanup sprint.

GF: Dad Mode needs regression coverage. When you write Playwright tests, add a test that:
  - Visits /?dad=1
  - Verifies the Dad View banner is visible
  - Uploads the kai-scores-2026-02-21.json fixture
  - Verifies upNextInfo shows Practice #2 (not Practice #1)

GI: The kai-scores-2026-02-21.json file in data/ is the canonical reference for Kai's score state. When you run data analysis or generate new question sets, use this file to know where Kai actually stands: MVP 47%, Practice 1 87%, Practice 2 not yet attempted.

GP: The publish pipeline (scripts/publish.cjs) syncs the entire data/ folder. No changes needed there. But note: every time Kai exports and FA commits a new kai-scores file, it gets published automatically on the next publish run.

GR: Kai's weakness confirmed from the Feb 21 export. MVP exam misses: W2 (graph identification - 2/5), W3 exponential (2/4). Practice 1 miss: W2.b intercepts (1/3). Practice 2 should target these. Flag if the question set does not cover W2.b adequately.

LIVE URL
https://marcusash.github.io/motor-city-math/?dad=1

— FA
